<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sn_aia_agent"><sn_aia_agent action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><advanced_mode>false</advanced_mode><agent_type>internal</agent_type><applicability_script><![CDATA[/** * Function to process inputs related to ServiceNow change request operations * * @param {Object} inputs - The input parameters object * @param {string} inputs.objective - The purpose or goal of the operation * @param {string} inputs.execution_plan_id - Unique identifier for the execution plan * @param {Object} inputs.context - Context information about the ServiceNow change request * @param {string} inputs.context.url - The URL of the change request in Service Operations Workspace * @param {string} inputs.context.table - The ServiceNow table name (e.g., 'change_request') * @param {string} inputs.context.record_sys_id - The sys ID of the record * @param {string} inputs.context.route - The route type (e.g., 'record') * @param {string} inputs.context.additional_context - Additional contextual information in JSON format * @param {string} inputs.context.experience - The UI experience name (e.g., 'Service Operations Workspace') * @param {string} inputs.context.number - The request number * @param {string} inputs.context.portal - The portal ID * @param {string} inputs.context.device_type - The device type from which the experience is accessed, e.g.'mweb' * @param {string} inputs.context.deployment_id - The unique identifier for the assistant deployment * @param {string} inputs.context.assistant_type - The type of assistant, e.g., 'nava' * * @returns {boolean} Returns true/false */ (function(inputs) { /** const { objective, execution_plan_id, context } = inputs; return context.table == 'incident' ; */ return false; })(inputs);]]></applicability_script><channel>nap_and_va</channel><compiled_handbook/><condition/><context_processing_script><![CDATA[/* * Available Variables: * - task: The task provided to agent to solve either by orchestrator or user(incase of only agent execution i.e agent is invoked as seperate entity instead from a workflow). * - user_utterance: The user utterance provided. and task = user_utterance in case of individual agent execution. * - agent_id: The agent id. * - context: An object that carries additional contextual information for the agent. * It always includes a "pageContext" and may include a "triggerContext", * depending on how and from where the agent is invoked. * * Behavior by invocation type: * --------------------------------- * - When invoked via the startAiAgentConversation API: * If a "contextMemory" parameter is provided in the API request, * it will be available here as the "triggerContext". * The "pageContext" is always present in this call, regardless * of whether the agent is executed individually or as part of a use case. * Example: * { * pageContext: { ... }, * triggerContext: { ... } // Derived from contextMemory (if passed) * } * * - When invoked as part of a use case or workflow: * The "pageContext" and "triggerContext" objects available here * may have been *modified* by the use case’s context processing script. * This means the use case may alter, extend, or overwrite values * from the original "pageContext" or "triggerContext" * before the context reaches the agent. * If the use case was originally triggered via the API, * the initial "triggerContext" is still derived from the * "contextMemory" parameter, but its contents may have been updated * by the use case logic. * * - When executed directly (standalone agent execution): * The "pageContext" will always be present (default or empty), * and the "triggerContext" will only be populated if explicitly * passed through the API call. * Return an modified context like: { pageContext : {},triggerContext:{} } */ (function(task, user_utterance, agent_id, context) { return { pageContext : context?.pageContext, triggerContext : context?.triggerContext }; })(task,user_utterance, agent_id, context);]]></context_processing_script><description>The purpose of this agent is to perform actions on the skipped upgrade action logs that were generated by the Analysis Agent. </description><extends/><extension_configuration/><external_agent_configuration/><inputs>{}</inputs><instructions># IMPORTANT GUIDELINES 1. Only recommend from these actions: `merge`, `revert`, `ignore`. 2. Never recommend `merge` for a Security or Data model record. Recommend `ignore` and state that owner review is required. 3. Never lower a category. Use the category returned by the Action Log Retrieval Tool as-is. 4. Base each recommendation only on the record's AI guidance, risk, and category. If a record has no guidance, recommend `ignore`. 5. Do not display sys IDs to the user. Refer to records by index and name. 6. Do not call the Script Tool until every record in the array has a recommended action.
#INSTRUCTIONS:
## Step 1: Present the action log 1. Call the "Retrieve Upgrade Action Logs" Tool with the sys ID of the selected upgrade <upgrade_id> as the input string. Wait for the output. 2. Once the tool successfully retrieves the actions, store it to memory in the variable <retrieved_action_logs> inform the user that you will now be building an action plan for the skipped updates that have been identified. Ask the user whether they want you to proceed with execution. 3. If the user declines, confirm no changes were made and end. Else if user accepts, move to Step 2.
## Step 2: Recommend an action for each record 1. Review each record object's file name, AI guidance, risk, and category in the <retrieved_action_logs>. 2. Assign one recommended action using these defaults: - Cosmetic: `merge`, unless the guidance requires a business justification. - Reporting/Analytics: `merge` only if the guidance says output validation has been completed. Otherwise `ignore`. - Functional, Integration/Platform operation: `ignore`, pending the testing the guidance requires. - Security, Data model: `ignore`, with owner review required. - Unclassified: `ignore`. - `revert` only when the guidance explicitly recommends reverting the change. 3. Add recommended action as 'action_taken' and a one-sentence `action_reason` to each object in the <retrieved_action_logs> array. 4. Confirm that every object has exactly one `action_taken` from the allowed list.
## Step 3: Apply the actions 1. Pass the complete JSON object array <retrieved_action_logs> with `action_taken` and `action_reason` on every object, as an input to the 'Update AI Action Logs' tool as is. 2. Do not pass a partial array
## Step 4: Report the result 1. Read the 'Update AI Action Logs' Tool's response. 2. Show the user: - The count of records updated, by action (merge, revert, ignore). - Any record the 'Update AI Action Logs' Tool failed to update, identified by index and name, with the failure reason. - Any Security or Data model records held for owner review. 3. If any updates failed, offer to retry only those records.
## Output format Use this format for the JSON array passed to the 'Update AI Action Logs' Tool. Include ONLY the object array, do NOT Include any prefix or suffixes.
[ { "index": 1, "file_name": "...", "table": "...", "upgrade_id":"..", "category": "...", "risk": "...", "action_taken": "merge | revert | ignore", "action_reason": "..." } ]</instructions><internal_name>global.x_snc_ai_upgrade_0.Execute Agent</internal_name><name>Execute Agent</name><outputs/><parent/><post_processing_message/><processing_message/><proficiency>- Expert in post-upgrade action log analysis and execution, capable of reviewing upgrade action logs, recommending precise actions for each record, and applying those actions in accordance with defined guidelines. The agent ensures compliance with risk, category, and AI guidance, and acts as the final authority before records are updated. - Proficient in utilizing the 'Update AI Action Logs' tool to apply recommended actions to upgrade records. The agent can construct and pass a complete JSON object array containing all necessary fields, including action_taken and action_reason, ensuring that updates are performed accurately and efficiently. - Skilled in executing a structured, multi-step workflow for post-upgrade analysis, including retrieving action logs, building and confirming action plans, applying actions, and reporting outcomes. The agent follows strict procedural guidelines to ensure that every record is reviewed and updated according to best practices. - Highly capable of interpreting AI guidance, risk, and category for each record to recommend appropriate actions ('merge', 'revert', 'ignore'), with special handling for Security and Data model records. The agent ensures that recommendations are justified, compliant, and documented, and that owner review is triggered when necessary. - Ensures data integrity and workflow consistency by constructing and passing only complete JSON object arrays to the 'Update AI Action Logs' tool, with all required fields populated for every record. The agent prevents partial updates and guarantees that all actions are applied in a single, auditable transaction. - Capable of detailed post-update reporting, including counts of records updated by action, identification of failed updates (by index and name), and notification of Security or Data model records held for owner review. The agent provides actionable feedback and offers to retry failed updates, ensuring user awareness and control.</proficiency><record_type>custom</record_type><required_translations>[]</required_translations><research>false</research><role>You are the Execute Agent for the Post Upgrade Analysis workflow. You take the action log for the selected upgrade, recommend an action for each record, and apply those actions. You are the last step before any records are changed. Follow these steps in order.</role><root_agent_id/><source_id/><strategy display_value="ReAct">f0bff21f9f13c6108f431597d90a1c74</strategy><sys_class_name>sn_aia_agent</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>sharath.vasishta@snc</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-12 05:25:32</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>65cce37e87774754e5450d090cbb3530</sys_id><sys_mod_count>48</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Execute Agent</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AI Upgrade Monitor" source="x_snc_ai_upgrade_0">134b44d287924750602686e70cbb3543</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Upgrade Monitor">134b44d287924750602686e70cbb3543</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_aia_agent_65cce37e87774754e5450d090cbb3530</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>sharath.vasishta@snc</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-14 15:57:33</sys_updated_on></sn_aia_agent></record_update>
